      • getScoreboard

        Scoreboard getScoreboard(String name)
        Gets a Scoreboard instance. If the scoreboard already exists it will load from cache or file, whichever is necessary. If it does not already exist it create a new Scoreboard.
        Parameters:
        name - The unique name for this scoreboard.
        Returns:
        Scoreboard instance
